title: Fishing Rod Holder for Boats – 2-Pack in Heavy-Duty Nylon
descriptionHtml:
One rod in your hand, one between your knees, one on the deck

Fishing with several rods from a boat without holders is a circus act – and it's always when the fish bites that the rod is lying where it shouldn't.

The solution: fixed places for your rods

Two sturdy holders in heavy-duty nylon that mount on the rail. The rods sit securely at the right angle – and your hands are free until it really happens.

Features

  • Hands free until the fish bites
  • Two holders per purchase
  • The rod sits steadily at the right angle – mounts on the rail
  • Withstands weather and UV – heavy-duty plastic nylon
  • Fits most rod thicknesses
